current_evidence: The council's 'Apply' page (wigan.gov.uk/Resident/Planning-and-Building-Control/Planning/Apply.aspx) links this same PDF as the 'Validation checklist' under Related Documents, and the PDF text says 'Adopted 21st May 2024'; no newer list or consultation was found.

issues.detail: List date is given as 2024-05-01, but the workbook's own date basis and the document say it was adopted on 21 May 2024. It should be 2024-05-21.

Eleven local requirements were not captured. L2 Air Quality Assessment: thresholds in Ch.6 of the Development and Air Quality SPD. L3 Bat and Bird Surveys: development, including LBC and demolition, that could affect roosting bats or nesting birds. L4 Draft BNG Statement / Draft Biodiversity Gain Plan with a completed metric: where the general biodiversity gain condition applies. L9 Ecological Appraisal (Extended Phase I): development affecting designated sites, important habitats or protected or priority species. L13 Green Belt Assessment: development in the Green Belt or Safeguarded Land, with volume and floorspace calculations for householder schemes. L16 Land Contamination Assessment: known or suspected contamination, development within 250m of a known landfill, or major sensitive end uses. L19 Minerals Assessment: major development in Mineral Safeguarding Areas or any mineral working. L20 Noise Impact Assessment: noisy industrial uses, commercial or entertainment uses with extraction or a shared party wall with housing, or noise-sensitive uses next to major noise sources. L26 Transport Assessment: use-class thresholds, e.g. C3 80+ dwellings, B2 4,000 sqm+, E(a) 1,500 sqm+. L30 Tree Works Specification: works to TPO trees or trees in a Conservation Area. L33 Waste Management Scheme: uses that process, transfer or deposit waste.
issues.evidence: Local Requirements L2, L3, L4, L9, L13, L16, L19, L20, L26, L30, L33

issues.detail: L12 Flood Risk Assessment does not appear under Full planning or any general type. It appears only under 'Change of use - prior approval'. The source triggers are: Flood Zone 2/3, including minor extensions and changes of use; over 1ha in Flood Zone 1; and over 0.5ha in Critical Drainage Areas.
issues.evidence: L12 Flood Risk Assessment: 'Development proposals: In flood zone 2 or 3, including minor extensions and change of use; ... sites over 1ha in Flood Zone 1 ...'

issues.detail: Several triggers come from the wrong paragraph. 'Crime prevention / Secured by Design statement' quotes CPD text plus the L8 SuDS paragraph, but L7 Crime Impact Statement applies to 10+ dwellings, 0.5ha+ or 1,000 sqm+. 'Fire Statement' quotes BNG ecologist text, but N12 applies to buildings 18m+ or 7+ storeys with 2+ dwellings or educational accommodation. 'Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment' quotes the L18 Lighting paragraph. 'Odour / Dust / Vibration assessment' is really the L20 Noise Impact Assessment contents list. 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage' quotes N7 site-plan scale text, but L33 is about waste processing, transfer or deposit uses.
issues.evidence: L7: '10 or more dwellings; site area 0.5ha+; 1,000 sqm+'; N12: 'buildings 18m+ in height or 7+ storeys'; L33 Waste Management Scheme Details

issues.detail: Many triggers are cut off or describe what the document should contain rather than when it is needed. 'Planning Statement' is just the header '12 L23 Planning Statement'; the source says major, complex or controversial proposals and departures. 'Coal Mining' is a fragment ('requirement for a Coal Mining Risk Assessment.'); the source says Development High Risk Area. 'Employment / Economic Statement' describes a market appraisal; the source says non-employment uses in Primary Employment Areas or sites over 0.4ha. 'Health Impact Assessment' describes contents; the source says Table 1 of the Planning for Health SPD and all EIA applications. 'Transport Statement' gives a definition only and none of the L27 use-class thresholds. 'Travel Plan' cites the GM toolkit; the source says it is required wherever a Transport Assessment is. 'Heritage Statement' says only that the detail varies. 'Advertisement drawings' is a fragment about illumination intensity.
issues.evidence: L23: 'major, complex or potentially controversial proposals'; L28: 'Development that requires a Transport Assessment (L26)'; L11: 'sites over 0.4ha in current or last employment use'

issues.detail: Three national-list triggers are truncated. The Design and Access Statement row says only 'Major development'; the source also lists 1+ dwellings in a Conservation Area, 100 sqm+ new floorspace in a Conservation Area, and Listed Building Consent. The Site Plan row says only 'Major developments'; N7 also covers householder extensions, commercial/industrial extensions, new buildings, schemes that increase parking demand, and free-standing adverts. The Sustainable Drainage row omits sites of 0.5ha+ in Critical Drainage Areas.
issues.evidence: N11: 'one or more dwellings in a Conservation Area; 100 sqm+ ... Listed Building Consent applications'; N7 Site Plans ALWAYS REQUIRED for ...

issues.detail: The 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' trigger is the validation-dispute (Article 12) boilerplate. N15 actually asks for a copy of any pre-application advice and any information requested at pre-app. 'Photographs / Photomontages' is not a requirement in the list: the excerpt is L30 Tree Works evidence text (photos of TPO trees) running into the L31 heading.
issues.evidence: N15 Pre-Application Information; L30 Tree Works Specification: 'labelled digital photographs of the existing tree(s)'

issues.detail: Two rows were placed by keyword match. 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' (L5 Carbon Reduction Strategy) sits under Outline only, because the text says 'This report must outline'; it actually applies to 10+ dwellings, 0.5ha+ or 1,000 sqm+ whatever the application type. 'Flood Risk Assessment' sits under 'Change of use - prior approval' only, because the trigger mentions 'change of use'.
issues.evidence: L5 trigger: '10+ dwellings; site of 0.5ha+; or 1,000 sqm+ floorspace'

issues.detail: About 30 requirements are flagged 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', e.g. Affordable Housing, Tree Survey, EV charging, Heritage Assessment, Structural Survey and Advertisement illumination. Some belong under other types. Advertisement illumination and L18 Lighting for illuminated or digital adverts belong under Advertisement consent. L24 Structural Survey also covers Listed Building and Conservation Area consent.
issues.evidence: L18: 'advertisement consent with illumination or digital screens'; L24: 'Listed Building or Conservation Area consent where the case relies on the structure's condition'

issues.detail: Several application types are marked '(none) - national requirements only' even though the list names local requirements for them. Householder: N7 site plan for householder extensions and L13 Green Belt volume calculations. Listed building consent: N11 DAS, L3 bat surveys and L24 structural survey. Advertisement consent: L18 lighting for illuminated adverts and the advert-specific N7/N8/N9 drawings. Works to trees: L30 Tree Works Specification and Evidence.
issues.evidence: N11 '...Listed Building Consent applications'; L13 '...calculations are also needed for householder development'; L30 'Works ... to trees covered by a Tree Preservation Order or in a Conservation Area'

issues.detail: Some tab items are process text or fragments, not requirements: 'Applicants must take note of the requirements as regards file format and size set out on Page 2', 'The Council aims to complete its validation check ... within 5 working days', the 'validation dispute' Article 12 paragraph, and 'The applicant should check that this is the case after converting CAD plans... 5 N8 Floor Plans ... are needed for:'. The page number '3.' is also attached to a drawing-standards item.
issues.evidence: Wigan tab_items, sections 'Submission rules' / 'Drawing / document standards'

issues.detail: 'Crime prevention / Secured by Design statement' and 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' have the same trigger excerpt (the L8 SuDS paragraph). 'Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment' and 'Lighting Assessment' also share the L18 lighting text.
issues.evidence: Both rows: 'Be able to demonstrate continuing crime prevention CPD L8 Sustainable Drainage Strategy ...'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Wigan validation checklist (adopted 21 May 2024, linked from the Apply page), but its list date is off by 20 days. The extraction misses about 11 local requirements (e.g. Air Quality, Bat/Bird, Ecology, Green Belt, Contamination, Noise, Transport Assessment). Many triggers are garbled or cut off, and several application types are wrongly marked as having no local requirements.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
